import nbformat, types
from sklearn import datasets
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import seaborn as sns

# local replacement for seaborn iris dataset

def my_load_iris_local():
    data = datasets.load_iris()
    X = data.data
    y = X[:,3]  # petal width
    X = X[:, :4]  # all 4 features
    # Need match original seaborn iris: columns sepal_length,sepal_width,petal_length,petal_width; then drop species and petal_width
    # Thus X has first 3 features only.
    X = data.data[:, :3]
    y = data.data[:, 3]
    return train_test_split(X, y, random_state=0, test_size=0.1)
